content.short: AIOZ W3S provides S3-compatible web3 object storage for developers and businesses, powered by DePIN.
content.description: AIOZ Web3 Storage (W3S) provides reliable, distributed, and scalable web3 cloud object storage at an affordable price. With a user-friendly interface and thorough documentation, it remains compatible with popular centralized storage options like Amazon S3. This combination gives web3 dApp developers a versatile object storage infrastructure that supports decentralized workloads while keeping costs practical and accessible across various networks.
